description: Reply asking a recruiter to take a work email off their recruiting lists and confirm
name: recruiterEmail
text:
Please remove this email address from your company’s recruiting and outreach mailing lists, and confirm once this has been completed. This is my work email address, and I do not consider it appropriate for recruiting solicitations.

Thanks,
Ari

description: Reply asking a company to take an email off its marketing lists and confirm
name: removeEmail
text:
Please remove my email address from all marketing and promotional mailing lists associated with your company, and confirm once the removal has been completed.

Thanks,
Ari
